basic_details.job_title: TISS Programme Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Hyderabad Off-Campus (TISS) has published the Recruitment 2026 notification for the post of Programme Manager. Online applications will be accepted till 06.11.2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification and Experience Programme Manager M.Com, MBA (Finance) with minimum 2 years in accounts and finance.

how_to_apply: Note: The Candidate applied earlier for this position vide ADVT/TISS/ADMIN/PM/HC/JUNE/2026 dated 19.06.2026 & ADVT /TISS /ADMIN /PM/ HC/JULY/2026 dated 08.07.2026 and subsequent, need not apply again and their application will be considered along with application received against this Advertisement.
Visit the official application portal at https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/.
Fill out the online application form with the required details.
Upload necessary documents, including the required certificate if claiming fee concession for SC/ST/PWD candidates.
Pay the application fee of Rs 500/- online (Rs 250/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates upon uploading the required Certificate).
Submit the application online on or before 06.11.2026.
Take a print of acknowledgment of online application and keep it for future reference.

content_sections.heading: About TISS Programme Manager
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a Grant-in-Aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Hyderabad Off-Campus of the Institute invites applications to fill one Programme Manager position on contract basis for a period of one year initially and extendable based on performance of the candidate and the requirement of the Institute.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: M.Com, MBA (Finance) with minimum 2 years in accounts and finance.

content_sections.heading: TISS Programme Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will handle the following duties and responsibilities: Maintain project accounts, prepare budgets and financial reports, process payments, manage TDS/GST compliance, P-Tax, coordinate audits, maintain vouchers and financial records, and provide administrative support. Budget tracking, vendor payments, expense verification, financial documentation, reporting, and coordination with finance and project teams.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Programme Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/ . Fill out the online application form with the required details. Upload necessary documents, including the required certificate if claiming fee concession for SC/ST/PWD candidates. Pay the application fee of Rs 500/- online (Rs 250/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates upon uploading the required Certificate). Submit the application online on or before 06.11.2026 . Take a print of acknowledgment of online application and keep it for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for Written/ Personal Interaction/ skill test for evaluating their proficiency and skills. Shortlisted Candidates will be informed over e-mail and/or mobile phone to appear for the Written/ Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Hyderabad. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the Personal Interaction, if it held at the Institute’s premises.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post advertised in the TISS recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Institute has advertised for the post of Programme Manager at the Hyderabad Campus.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Programme Manager position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date for filling online applications is 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Com or MBA (Finance) degree along with a minimum of 2 years in accounts and finance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 40 years, with the Institute reserving the right to relax age based on work experience.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs 500/- to be paid online. SC/ST/PWD candidates pay Rs 250/- if they upload the required Certificate in the Online Application Form, and women applicants are exempted from payment of application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Are candidates who applied under previous notifications required to apply again?
faq.answer: No, candidates who applied earlier vide ADVT/TISS/ADMIN/PM/HC/JUNE/2026 dated 19.06.2026 & ADVT /TISS /ADMIN /PM/ HC/JULY/2026 dated 08.07.2026 need not apply again.
